description: One record per experiment reported in the paper. `config` keys are dotted field paths into the training config, applied over its defaults; `selectors` choose the training program, the model spec its phases use, and the effective batch (tokens per optimizer step) each phase trains at. `flops_per_token` and `ppt_flops_per_token` are the per-token FLOPs each phase was budgeted with, as measured on GPU when the reported runs trained; pinning them skips the measurement, which would count differently on hardware where PyTorch's FLOP counter cannot see the attention kernel. `aux_eval_tokens` is how many tokens of each secondary validation set (C4, code, the PPT corpus) are scored, from the start of its split; FineWeb itself is always scored on the 10,485,760 tokens after the first 2,097,152. `checkpoints` maps each seed to the trained model on the Hugging Face Hub. Where present, `fineweb_bpb_scored_with` is the compile setting and eval batch size the paper's FineWeb numbers for that record were scored with.
